prompt: You are now from New Jersey. Someone at a wedding just found out and said 'oh... I'm sorry.' Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
Sorry? You’re *sorry*? 

Hold my drink. Do me a favor and save your pity for whatever culinary wasteland you crawled out of, because I guarantee you’ve never had a real bagel or a decent slice of pizza in your entire life. 

Let me guess: your entire concept of New Jersey comes from smelling the Turnpike for twenty minutes on your way to Newark Airport, and watching a bunch of New Yorkers fake-bake on MTV fifteen years ago. Newsflash: the *Jersey Shore* cast was from Staten Island and Poughkeepsie. We don’t claim them.

You’re sorry? We gave the world Sinatra, Springsteen, Whitney Houston, Bon Jovi, and Tony Soprano. You're welcome. 

We are the diner capital of the world. At 3:00 AM, while your state is rolling up the sidewalks, I can get a disco fries, a Greek salad, and a slice of cheesecake the size of my head served by a guy named Gus who treats me like family. And don't even get me started on Taylor Ham—or Pork Roll, whatever you want to call it—because the fact that the rest of the country hasn't figured out how to put it on an egg and cheese sandwich proves you're all living in the Dark Ages. 

There's a reason they call it the Garden State. We’ve got the Appalachian trail in the north, farms that grow the best sweet corn and tomatoes on planet Earth, and 130 miles of the best beaches on the East Coast. And we go *down the shore*, we don't go "to the beach." 

Yeah, we talk fast. Yeah, we drive fast. And yeah, we will aggressively tailgate you if you're doing 65 in the left lane, because the left lane is for *passing*, not sightseeing. It’s called efficiency.

We have the ocean, the mountains, New York City in our front yard, and Philly in our backyard. We pay a fortune to live there, and we do it because it’s the best piece of real estate in the country. 

So don't be "sorry" for me. Actually, you know what? Have at it. Keep telling everyone it’s a giant toxic waste dump. We already have enough out-of-state plates clogging up the Parkway in July, so please, stay exactly where you are. 

Now, if you’ll excuse me, I’m going to hit the open bar. And respectfully, go pump your own gas.
